##### Project general facts

Introducing Harbour Gate Apartments, an exquisite twin-stepped tower development crafted by Emaar Properties. Nestled in the scenic Dubai Creek Harbour, this luxurious residential complex offers a range of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. With their elegant design, these units provide unobstructed views of the lush parkland and shimmering waters of the Creek, creating a captivating sight.

Located on Creek Island, residents of Harbour Gate Apartments have convenient access to a wide array of leisure and recreational facilities. Situated at the central base, the development is easily reachable from the circle boulevard. The Creek Marina is just a short walk away, while Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport can be reached within 10 to 15 minutes by car. Additionally, the strategic location allows seamless access to major roadways, ensuring effortless connectivity to various parts of Dubai.

Immerse yourself in the mesmerizing vistas of the verdant parkland below, engaging your senses in a tranquil ambiance. The glittering lights of Dubai Creek Harbour further evoke a sense of awe and wonder in the surrounding environment. Take a moment to unwind in the serene shaded alleyway leading to the park, offering access to a range of shops and leisure activities along the boulevard.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Creek Harbour is a large-scale, waterfront development positioned along the shores of the historic Dubai Creek. The development is designed to offer a harmonious blend of urban living and natural landscapes. One of the focal points of Dubai Creek Harbour is the iconic Dubai Creek Tower, set to become the tallest structure in the world once completed. It is envisioned as a landmark architectural marvel, inspired by the shape of a blossoming lily. The tower will offer breathtaking views of the city skyline and serve as a symbol of Dubai's innovative spirit and grandeur.

Dubai Creek Harbour also incorporates extensive green spaces and parklands, emphasizing the importance of sustainability and promoting a healthy and active lifestyle. The development includes landscaped parks, jogging and cycling tracks, and waterfront promenades, creating a vibrant and inclusive environment for residents and visitors alike. The retail and entertainment offerings at Dubai Creek Harbour are centered around Creek Marina, an attractive destination with a marina promenade, high-end shopping outlets, and a diverse range of dining options. The marina provides berthing facilities for private yachts, adding to the overall appeal of the waterfront lifestyle.

The development also aims to become a cultural hub, with plans for the Dubai Creek Harbour Art District. This district will showcase various art installations, galleries, and exhibitions, fostering creativity and establishing Dubai Creek Harbour as a vibrant cultural destination. Furthermore, Dubai Creek Harbour is strategically located near key transport links, including the Dubai International Airport and major highways, ensuring easy accessibility to other parts of the city.
